title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  Each morning I assemble the same face and hope it holds till dark.
ii.  A photograph insists: this happened, this was warm.
iii.  I counted my breaths to be sure they were mine. The number changes.
iv.  The mirror agrees with me, mostly. It is the mostly I keep.
v.  They tell me the rain is only weather. Then why does it knock to be let in.
colophon: rain that mostly forgets, and a few drops it decides to hold.
